verdict.stance: Neutral / Kuwait Sovereign-Supported Bank with Turkey IAS 29 Drag (A+ Fitch / BBB+ CI)
verdict.summary: Core Kuwait franchise expanded cleanly in 9M26 (assets KWD 9.4bn, deposits KWD 5.5bn +6%, loans KWD 5.1bn +8%, CoR 50bp), though headline NPAT dipped to KWD 22m (vs 32m) under Burgan Turkey IAS 29 hyperinflation accounting. Monitor Dec-2026 call/reset decision on $500m 2.75% T2 2031 (XS2265369491).

positives: Strong Kuwait systemic support underpinning Fitch A+ IDR (despite weaker standalone VR) and CBK regulatory backing.
Core Kuwait loan/deposit growth (+8% / +6% YoY) with cost of credit easing to 50bp.
Comfortable compliance above CBK's 13% CAR floor.
negatives: Burgan Bank Turkey subsidiary creates ongoing IAS 29 hyperinflation net monetary loss drag (9M26 NPAT KWD 22m vs 32m).
Majority ownership by leveraged parent KIPCO (~BB- Fitch) constrains standalone profile vs NBK/KFH.
Regional MENAT subsidiary exposure (Algeria, Tunisia, Turkey, Iraq).

background.business_overview: Kuwait's second-largest conventional commercial bank (~KWD 9.4bn assets), core banking subsidiary of KIPCO Group.
background.asset_perimeter: Kuwait core corporate/retail banking plus subsidiaries in Turkey, Algeria (AGB), Tunisia (TIB), and Bank of Baghdad legacy/regional.
background.ownership_governance: Majority controlled by KIPCO (~64%); listed on Boursa Kuwait; CBK-regulated D-SIB.

Dec-26 Catalyst: Upcoming first call/reset window on $500m 2.75% Tier 2 due Dec 2031 (XS2265369491).
